decisions.reason: After surviving its first full year, this core door lever family likely remains because German spec-driven architectural hardware suppliers favor continuity in standard ranges for planners, installers and repeat projects.
The mitred lever family still fits the firm's design-oriented portfolio and, absent signs of weak acceptance, is more likely to be retained than withdrawn after the earlier portfolio cleanup.
This award-backed door and window handle collection looks like a flagship family with strong design and specification value, so it is very unlikely to be removed now.
A finish remains easier to rationalize than a full product family, but this patinated bronze option supports the firm's premium architecture-led offering and is still more likely to stay available.
